scope: Independent read-only source review. No engine runs or production edits.

state_and_resource_findings.finding: Invoked random draws are in the newly constructed disposable BattleAftermath instance. CombatEffects and BattleAftermath initialize instance-owned RandomNumberGenerator seeds. The wrapper does not invoke live shot/impact/death/death_motion entry points or global rand functions.

The scene tree is paused before construction. Disposable renderers do not allocate live projectile rounds. burst(point, strength, false) avoids the scar route to game.battlefield_wear; created rigid bodies are frozen before the next await and collide only with terrain.

Proxy mesh and base material references are read/shared without setters on those resources. Wreck StandardMaterial3D, hit ShaderMaterial, effect materials and projectile pools are newly allocated; hit overlay writes affect proxy instances only.

The disposable wear _create_texture method initially binds the live terrain but does not assign its material_overlay. The synchronous wrapper redirects _terrain to terrain_proxy before _paint; resulting overlay and texture marks belong to the proxy/disposable wear.

The archived prototype run reports equal save snapshots, equal captured live counters/RNG states and identical node count 6691 before/after. These checks support the exercised fresh-start scenario, not every options or restore state.

concrete_required_guard.issue: CombatEffects._shockwave returns without adding a node, but the wrapper unconditionally indexes spare._shockwaves[0].
concrete_required_guard.recommendation: Skip this optional variant or check that the pool is nonempty before setting progress; do not alter the user preference to force it.

variant_coverage.assessment: Uses the same CombatEffects factory for all eight emitters, including GPU debris. Emits with each factory mesh/shader/process material and enables processing while paused.
Uses the same factories and same shader/material flags. Shockwave coverage is renderer/settings conditional; debris uses the disposable aftermath and ground_hit=false.

Creates the actual ProjectileRenderer pools and draws one instance from all six visual kinds; exact MultiMesh color/interpolation and lit/unshaded factory variants are retained without a gameplay round.
Creates the same two stamp kinds and terrain-overlay shader; actual overlay drawing still respects battlefield_wear and graphics_ground_detail options.

Uses exact hit-flash shader and wreck StandardMaterial3D flags on representatives of currently loaded MeshInstance3D classes/surface-format lists. This is bounded coverage: the dedup key does not include primitive topology, shadow state, winding, skin/blend flags, per-surface overrides or MultiMesh instance mode. Only the initial 30-unit fixture is present before the later 40 combat units spawn.

remaining_validation: For production promotion, assert live terrain overlay identity and live material resource/property fingerprints before and after, in addition to snapshot/counter equality.
Exercise reduced flashes and disabled wear/ground detail; verify no invalid indexing and restore the original paused state.
Define the intended vertex/instance/shadow variants and ensure dedup keys cover the properties that select those pipelines; do not claim all-faction or all-later-unit coverage from this fixture.

The recorded later combat warm-up still compiled 3 draw, 1 surface and 3 specialization pipelines in a 79.659 ms frame. The prototype substantially reduced observed long tails but did not eliminate every first-use compilation.
performance_limit: One isolated native foreground diagnostic with OS/driver caches unreset supports further controlled implementation and measurement; it is not a production acceptance result.
